name: Restrained Editorial Clarity
designThesis: Elevated, content-first readability with disciplined typographic scale, generous asymmetric whitespace, and muted tonal surfaces. Eliminates artificial decorative chrome in favor of clear semantic hierarchy.

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Warm off-white (#fbfbf9) in light mode; deep obsidian graphite (#0d0e11) in dark mode
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Single accent (burnt amber or cold slate) reserved exclusively for active navigation and primary text highlights
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Minimum 7.0:1 AAA on body copy; 4.5:1 AA on secondary captions

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Editorial serif display (Newsreader / Playfair / Charter) paired with neutral humanist sans body (Inter / Geist / system-ui)
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: High contrast between display titles and body text; tight line tracking on titles, generous 1.65 line-height on long-form prose
typographyStrategy.scaleFactor: 1.333 (Perfect Fourth) modular scale with max reading width clamped to 68ch

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: 12-column asymmetric grid with wide margins (min 48px), offset blockquotes, and dedicated margin annotation rail
layoutRhythm.whitespaceDiscipline: Generous vertical cadence (48px–96px between semantic chapters); zero cramped card containers

surfaceTreatment.radius: 2px to 4px subtle rounded corners; sharp architectural edges on structural panels
surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 1px hairline solid using semi-transparent border tokens (var(--ot-border-subtle))
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Flat planar elevation with subtle ambient contact shadows (0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04))

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Underlined textual links or restrained hairline outline buttons with subtle background fill on hover
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Borderless or hairline-bounded content cells with generous internal padding (min 24px) and zero gradient fills
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Open tabular layout with subtle horizontal rules only; no vertical borders, right-aligned numeric data

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Prominent 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset; skip-to-content link always present at document start
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: All scroll and fade transitions disabled or collapsed to immediate 0ms when prefers-reduced-motion is active

antiPatterns: Overcrowded multi-column sidebars on reading pages
Unclamped text containers exceeding 80 characters per line

browserChecks: Verify text readability at 100%, 150%, and 200% zoom
Verify line-length clamps across viewports (375px to 1440px)
Verify high contrast mode renders all text with system borders
